groups.sentence: Instructors may permit AI for editing, proofreading, grammar help or style adjustment in their course.
Instructors decide and tell students whether AI editing tools are allowed in the course.
Students may use AI to check grammar, spelling and proofread their own writing.
Students may use AI to polish, revise and edit their own drafts for clarity, style and tone.
Students may use AI to outline, plan and organize their ideas.
Students may use AI as a general writing aid or assistant.
Students may use AI to format citations, references, bibliographies and documents.
AI can help with editing and grammar, but it may rewrite text or fall short of other help.
Students must not use generative AI on writing assignments, including drafting or copy-editing.
Students are encouraged to use AI to proofread, outline, revise and edit their work.
Students must not use AI to generate, rewrite, restructure or make major revisions to their content.
